untranslated.label: Untranslated pages

signups.label: Sign-ups
signups.description: Anyone can make an account on the site. Off, only someone who can add accounts makes them.

mentions.label: Mentions
mentions.description: @name links to the profile with that slug, once it's published. A name that isn't anyone's stays text.
mentions.caption: @name links to a profile

smart_punctuation.label: Smart punctuation
smart_punctuation.description: Straight quotes become curly ones, -- and --- dashes, and ... an ellipsis. Code is left as written.
smart_punctuation.caption: Quotes, dashes, and ellipses are typographic

heading_anchors.label: Heading anchors
heading_anchors.description: Each heading gets a link to itself, so a section can be shared.

figures.label: Images as figures

html.label: Raw HTML
html.description: What HTML written in content does on the page, whoever wrote it. Who may add HTML in the admin is up to their role.

embeds.label: Embeds turned on
embeds.description: A site turned on plays its links on the page; the others keep their links as links.

api.label: API
api.description: An API of what the site shows, as JSON, for other sites, apps, and AI tools: its pages, types, media, and menus. Drafts and hidden pages are never in it without a token, and only a token may change content.
api.caption: The site has an API

api_access.label: Who can read it
api_access.description: A token is made on Your Account, and acts as the account it belongs to.

trailing_slash.label: Trailing slash
trailing_slash.description: The other form redirects, so links to either still work.

sitemap_disallow.label: Paths robots.txt asks to skip
sitemap_disallow.description: One path a line, each starting with /, such as /drafts/.

llms.caption: Every page has a Markdown copy, and the site has llms.txt

mcp.label: MCP server
mcp.description: Lets AI apps, such as Claude and ChatGPT, read and write entries and media as the people who connect them, with what those people may do. Each person approves an app when they connect it.
mcp.caption: Apps can connect

llms_full.description: Every page llms.txt lists, in full, in one file, so a tool can read the whole site at once. It can be several megabytes on a large site.
llms_full.caption: The site has llms-full.txt

block_ai.label: Ask to stay away
block_ai.description: robots.txt is a request: well-behaved crawlers follow it, others may not.

date_format.one_line: A format is one line, without control characters.
date_format.not_field: "{letter}" isn't a date or time field; put words in single quotes, such as 'at'.
date_format.unclosed: A quote isn't closed; write two ('') for a quote itself.
date_format.no_field: A format needs a field at least, such as d, MMMM, or y.

fields.conflict: {problem} Read it again with get_entry, then make the change on what's there now.
fields.revision_required: Send the "revision" get_entry answered, so no one else's change is lost.

get_type.title: Get a Content Type
get_type.description: Gets one content type in full: its fields (names, kinds, which are required, what each is for), a JSON Schema of an entry's fields, the statuses an entry can have and the transitions between them (its workflow), its relationships to other types (such as tags or authors, set by the related entries' slugs), and what this connection may do with it. Call it before create_entry or update_entry.

set_status.title: Change Status
set_status.description: Changes an entry's status, by a transition of its type's workflow (get_type lists them): send "status" ("published" puts it on the site now, "draft" takes it off, "scheduled" puts it on at a future "date") or a "transition" by name. Only use it when the person asked for the change. Needs the revision get_entry answered.
set_status.one_of: Send a "status" or a "transition", not both.

list_types.title: List Content Types
list_types.description: Lists the site's content types (posts, pages, and the site's own): each one's name, label, kind (a dated collection, or a tree of pages), a line about it, and how many entries this connection can see. Call it first to learn what the site has; call get_type before writing an entry of a type.

edit_body.title: Edit Part of a Body
edit_body.description: Replaces one passage of an entry's Markdown body with new text, for a small change such as a typo or a sentence, without sending the whole body back. "find" must be copied exactly from the body get_entry answered and appear in it exactly once; send more of the text around it when it's found more than once. Needs the revision get_entry answered.

create_entry.title: Create a Draft
create_entry.description: Creates a new entry, a draft unless its type's workflow starts elsewhere: a type, a title, its fields (by the names get_type gives; relationships such as tags take the related entries' slugs), and a Markdown body. It's never published; set_status does that, when asked. Answers the entry, with its revision and links to review it in the site's editor and to preview it.
create_entry.no_status: New entries are drafts; leave "status" out, and use set_status after, when asked to publish.

get_media.title: Get a Media File
get_media.description: Gets one file in the media library by id: its address, dimensions, alt text, caption, sizes, and other details, and the entries that use it.
get_media.not_found: No media file has the id "{id}".
get_media.unreadable: The media library can't be read: {problem}

update_media.title: Update a Media File
update_media.description: Changes a media file's alt text, caption, or title, by its id. Alt text describes an image for someone who can't see it; keep it to a sentence. An empty value clears one.
update_media.unreadable: The media library can't be read: {problem}
update_media.not_found: No media file has the id "{id}".

trash_entry.title: Move an Entry to the Trash
trash_entry.description: Moves an entry to the trash, off the site; restore_entry brings it back. When live entries link to it, it names them and does nothing until it's sent again with confirm: true. Needs the revision get_entry answered.
trash_entry.linked: {count, plural, one {# live entry links} other {# live entries link}} to “{title}”: {entries}{more, select, yes {, and more} other {}}. Trashing it takes it off the site, and those links stop working. Send confirm: true to trash it anyway.
trash_entry.trashed: Moved “{title}” to the trash; restore_entry brings it back.

reindex.title: Reindex Content
reindex.description: Update the content and media indexes from the files, without pulling or clearing other caches.
reindex.indexed_more: Indexed {entries, plural, one {# entry} other {# entries}}: {added} added, {changed} changed, {removed} removed. Indexed {files, plural, one {# media file} other {# media files}}. {pending} more are being read in the background.
reindex.indexed: Indexed {entries, plural, one {# entry} other {# entries}}: {added} added, {changed} changed, {removed} removed. Indexed {files, plural, one {# media file} other {# media files}}.
reindex.unindexed: {summary} {count, plural, one {# file} other {# files}} couldn't be indexed.

search_entries.title: Search Entries
search_entries.description: Finds entries (posts, pages, and the site's other types) by words, type, status, relationship (such as a tag or an author), parent page, and dates. Answers short summaries (id, type, title, status, address, dates, excerpt) without bodies; read one in full with get_entry. Finds drafts and scheduled entries this connection may see as well as published ones, but not the trash unless status asks for it.
search_entries.found: Found {count, plural, one {# entry} other {# entries}}.
search_entries.no_relationship: There's no "{name}" relationship to filter by; get_type lists a type's relationships.
search_entries.not_a_date: "{field}" must be a date, such as 2026-01-31; "{value}" isn't one.
search_entries.cursor: "cursor" must be the next_cursor a search answered.

search_media.title: Search Media
search_media.description: Finds files in the media library (images, video, audio, documents) by kind, by words in their name, title, alt text, or caption, and those missing alt text. Answers each file's id, address, size, title, alt text, and caption; get_media adds where it's used.
search_media.cursor: "cursor" must be the next_cursor a search answered.
search_media.unreadable: The media library can't be read: {problem}
search_media.found: Found {count, plural, one {# file} other {# files}}.

clear_caches.title: Clear Caches
clear_caches.description: Empty the page, body, and fragment caches, so every page renders fresh.

get_entry.title: Get an Entry
get_entry.description: Gets one entry in full, by its id or its address on the site: its fields, its Markdown body exactly as written, its relationships, and, when this connection may edit it, its revision (which update_entry, edit_body, set_status, and trash_entry need) and links to edit and preview it. Add include: ["linked_from"] to list the entries that link to it, before trashing or unpublishing it.
get_entry.redirects: "{url}" redirects to {to}; ask for that address instead.

restore_entry.title: Restore an Entry
restore_entry.description: Brings an entry back from the trash at its workflow's first status, a draft unless its type says otherwise. search_entries with status ["trash"] finds what's there.

publish.title: Publish
publish.description: Put content changes live: pull (when set up), reindex, and clear the caches.
publish.unindexed: Published, but {count, plural, one {# file} other {# files}} couldn't be indexed.
publish.published_more: Published in {ms} ms. {pending, plural, one {# more media file is} other {# more media files are}} being read in the background.

upload_media.title: Upload a Media File
upload_media.description: Adds a file to the media library from its contents, as base64, with its file name (whose extension says its type), and alt text and a caption. Only the types the site takes, up to the sizes it allows; never SVG. Answers the file with its id, for a media field such as image, and its address, for a body's Markdown image.
upload_media.not_base64: "data" must be the file's contents as base64.
upload_media.uploaded_unsaved: Uploaded {name}. Its alt text and caption weren't saved: {problem}

update_entry.title: Update an Entry
update_entry.description: Changes an entry: only the fields given (null removes one), a whole new Markdown body, a new slug, or, for a page, a new parent page. Needs the revision get_entry answered; if someone changed it since, it's refused, so read it again. For a small change to the body, use edit_body instead. To publish or unpublish, use set_status.
update_entry.no_status: Change the status with set_status, not update_entry.

tool_job.label: Run a tool
tool_job.no_tool: The job doesn't say which tool to run, or with what.
tool_job.no_account: The account that asked for it is gone or suspended.

tools.queued: Queued; it runs in the background.

tool_entries.no_type: There's no "{name}" type; list_types says which there are.
tool_entries.no_entry: There's no entry with the id "{id}" that this connection may see.
tool_entries.no_published: There's no published entry at "{url}"; search_entries finds drafts.

notify_job.label: Send a notification
notify_job.damaged: This job doesn't say what to send, or to whom.
notify_job.unknown: Nothing sends "{notification}" any more; its plugin may be off.
notify_job.no_transport: The site can't send mail: it has no transport.
notify_job.no_recipient: Not sent: the account is gone, suspended, or has no email address.
notify_job.fanned_out: Queued for {count, plural, =0 {no accounts} one {# account} other {# accounts}}

invite.subject: Your account on {site}
invite.body: An account was made for you on {site}, with the username {username}. Choose a password to sign in.

forgot.subject: Reset your password on {site}
forgot.body: Someone asked to reset the password of {username} on {site}. Choose a new one with this link.
forgot.note: The link works once, until {date}. If you didn't ask, ignore this email: your password hasn't changed.

reset.subject: Choose a new password on {site}
reset.body: An administrator of {site} sent you a link to choose a new password for {username}. Your current password works until you do.

email_change.label: Email address changes

confirm.subject: Confirm the new email address of {site}
confirm.body: {name} asked to make this the email address of {site}, where it sends notices for its owner. Confirm it with this link; until you do, notices go to {old}.

asked.subject: The email address of {site} is changing
asked.body: {name} asked to change the email address of {site} from this one to {email}. It changes once that address confirms it.
asked.note: If you didn't expect this, sign in and change the address back on Settings → General before it's confirmed.

changed.subject: The email address of {site} changed
changed.body: The email address of {site} is {email} now, so notices for its owner go there instead of here.
changed.note: If you didn't expect this, sign in and check Settings → General.

email_change.confirm_note: The link works once, until {date}. If you didn't expect this, ignore this email: nothing changes.

confirm.subject: Confirm your new email address on {site}
confirm.body: You asked to make this the email address of {username} on {site}. Confirm it with this link; until you do, your account keeps the one it has.

asked.subject: Your email address on {site} is changing
asked.body: Someone signed in as {username} on {site} asked to change its email address from this one to {email}. It changes once that address confirms it.
asked.note: If it wasn't you, sign in and change your password, then tell the site's administrators.

changed.subject: Your email address on {site} changed
changed.body: The email address of {username} on {site} is {email} now, so its email goes there instead of here.
changed.body_by: {name}, an administrator of {site}, changed the email address of {username} to {email}, so its email goes there instead of here.
changed.note: If you didn't expect this, tell the site's administrators.

transitions.no_way: There's no way for {items} to go from {from} to {to}.
transitions.not_in_workflow: The status {to} isn't one {items} use; use one of: {statuses}.
transitions.not_allowed: You aren't allowed to {transition} that entry.
transitions.cannot_publish: You aren't allowed to publish that entry.
transitions.cannot_unpublish: You aren't allowed to take that entry off the site.

writer.no_status: The site has no "{name}" status of its own.
writer.status_used: {count, plural, one {The {workflows} workflow uses it} other {The {workflows} workflows use it}}; take it out of {count, plural, one {it} other {them}} first.
writer.not_customizable: There's no "{name}" workflow from Blush or a plugin to customize.
writer.no_workflow: The site has no "{name}" workflow of its own.
writer.workflow_used: {types} {count, plural, one {uses it} other {use it}}; choose another workflow in {count, plural, one {its} other {their}} Type Settings first.
